topic: Update calibration for specific ad category
summary_markdown: The conversation revolves around updating calibration values for the `Airport_telt200` category associated with company 7897. Initially, a request was made to set the value to 84 (for both production and staging). This was then canceled by [p1]. Later, [p1] requested an update to set the calibration value to 78 for both environments. The conversation also touched upon running a recalculation for four months on production with a new model, which [me] approved. Finally, it was confirmed that no changes would be made to facilities with explicitly defined calibrations.
decisions: The calibration value for `Airport_telt200` (company 7897) is set to 78 for both production and staging environments.
action_items: Update the calibration for `Airport_telt200` (company 7897) to 78 in production and staging.
